prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1481; do not mention it.)
text: This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the rear-end collision described in your file. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. Our client was struck from behind while stopped in traffic and has since been receiving medical treatment for injuries that continue to affect daily activities and work. We ask that you provide a written statement of the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to the at-fault driver, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to the incident, including the claim file, photographs, vehicle data, recorded statements, repair estimates, and any dash camera or telematics records. Please confirm receipt of this letter and your preservation of these materials in writing within ten days.
